question: Thorny trees and bushes are found in which part of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**North - western.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thorny trees and bushes** are found in the **North-western **part of India.
 
• The region of North-western India is known for its **arid climate and desert landscapes** which are home to various thorny trees and bushes.
 
• Some of the common thorny trees and bushes found in this region include** Acacia, Prosopis, and Capparis**.
 
• These trees and bushes have adapted to the **harsh climate and sandy soil **of the region and are an important part of the local ecosystem.
 
• The thorny trees and bushes also have various uses such as providing** shade, fodder for livestock, and wood for fuel and construction.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Eastern part of India** is known for its **lush green forests and tropical climate** which are not suitable for thorny trees and bushes.
 
• The **Southern part of India** has a diverse range of landscapes including **forests, hills, and coastal regions**.
 
• The **North-Eastern part of India** is known for its **dense forests and hilly terrain** which are not suitable for thorny trees and bushes.
